status_definitions.proofclosed: Complete scoped proof accepted; conditional hypotheses and inherited dependencies remain explicit.
status_definitions.active: A concrete extension or certificate is actively being investigated.
status_definitions.conditionalclosed: The implication is proved. A missing constructive premise is a separate task.
status_definitions.guardedclosed: The guarded theorem is final; a broader extension remains open.
status_definitions.reviewpending: Reconstructed text exists but independent final-hash acceptance is pending.
status_definitions.blocked: A specific constructive premise is still missing.
status_definitions.candidate: Proposed implication with no accepted complete proof.
status_definitions.priorityknown: Known/classical ingredient or subsumed headline; never inferred from proof acceptance.
status_definitions.implementationpending: Paper proof does not establish production correctness, numerical robustness or measured speed.
